description: This file implements platform-specific backtrace and stack trace functionalities, including support for Linux, Android, and Windows, with conditional compilation and demangling of function names.

classes.name: GetBacktraceImpl
classes.description: Platform-specific implementation class for capturing and symbolizing backtraces, with different versions for Linux, Android, and Windows.

classes.name: SymbolHelper
classes.description: Singleton class managing Windows symbol initialization and cleanup.

classes.name: AndroidBacktraceState
classes.description: Structure to hold buffer of stack addresses for Android backtrace.

classes.name: LazyBacktrace
classes.description: Lazy evaluation class for backtrace string, used in get_lazy_backtrace.

methods.name: get_backtrace
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current call stack, with options to skip frames and omit Python frames.

methods.name: get_lazy_backtrace
methods.description: Returns a lazy-evaluated backtrace object that computes the string representation on demand.
